approach: Evaluation-only dual-model consensus: intersect independently ranked, filtered, distinct primary-index top-eight pools. Rank shared records by equal reciprocal rank fusion with offset 60, UUID tie break. Consider only the first consensus record; append at most one absent record to unused MiniLM slots. Do not remove existing records before consensus or advance to another candidate if the winner fails.
features: Primary-index score/rank pairs independent of expected identities. Gate consensus winner by E5 cosine, MiniLM cosine and fused top-one minus top-two margin. Require at least two shared candidates; otherwise reject. Expected facts/answerability only used for scoring.
selection: Use original/fresh/new development only. First screen all 210 policies for possible complete-answer gains and zero changed negative returned identities. This screen is an optimistic upper bound on full-packet delivery, not native packet evaluation. Any potential survivor requires actual native packet rendering, the unchanged per-record comparator, historical development, then heldout evaluation before production consideration. Never use oracle labels for admission or retune queries after scoring.
fallback: If no safe potential gain, reject the additive family without scoring heldout or adding a second production model. Record missed-gold ranks and stronger negative-margin counterexamples. No production model, download/release, schema or threshold change.
registered_after: Top-one E5 family has zero potential complete-answer gains on all 11 original/fresh/new development misses. Correct E5 primary ranks: 2,13,2,5,14; 12,2,6; 3,10,3. New hypothesis follows that failure; no candidate heldout scoring.
